card.fires_on: The pole fires on the piece right after "AC" or "ACT" in regimen and brand names, such as the EM in ACTEMRA, or the arrow or hyphen in AC→paclitaxel and AC-TH. It also fires on a few scattered words, such as "a" and "pay" in a ground-rent sentence.
